locations.note: A condensed Edinburgh, from the castle rock to Princes Street, is the map's city, raced through all four seasons.
The Lake District's fells and lakeside roads form the map's north-west.
The Highlands: single-track roads, lochs and bare hills in the north of the map.
The Cotswolds' stone villages and hedged lanes fill the map's south.
Bamburgh Castle on its rock above the beach, the map's north-east coast.
Derwentwater, the lake the map's Lake District is drawn around.
Drivers race through Ambleside, the slate town at the head of Windermere.
Broadway, with its wide honey-stone street, is the Cotswold village of the map.
